Claire —

Thanks for the fast follow. Quick read looks promising; appreciate the early-bird terms. Before we sign, two things for our side:

1) Speaking slot: our GTM team prefers a 45-minute session (30 min talk + 15 min Q&A) or a 2-person panel. Can you confirm whether the Developer Tools track can extend to 45 minutes or swap in a panel moderator seat?

2) Logo placement: "prominent" on the main stage is great, but we need confirmation of relative sizing and placement (e.g., top row vs. bottom row on the backdrop, and a PNG we can preview). Also request priority placement in the printed program and banner on the registration landing page.

3) Lead capture & compliance: we require that any lead data collected via event devices is stored according to our MDP (short version attached). We also need a statement about how long event organizers retain scanned badge data and whether exports include IP or device identifiers. If you have a SOC2 or vendor assessment we could reference, please share.

If these items are workable we can move quickly on signatures and payment. Looping in Laura (legal) and Vivek (marketing ops) for any contract/compliance redlines.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships (North America)
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Great questions. Quick answers below:

- Speaking slot: We can extend to 45 minutes on the Developer Tools track. A panel is also possible if you provide a moderator; we'll advertise it as a 45-minute session.
- Logo placement: We guarantee top-two row placement for the "Exhibitor + Keynote" tier; logo dimensions on the stage backdrop will be 1000px (long edge) at production scale — we can provide a mockup PNG for approval once a contract is signed. We'll also include your logo at the top of the printed program and on the registration landing page as requested.
- Lead capture: Standard option is a single-scan lead retrieval provided by our vendor (BoothWorks). They export CSV with name, company, email, and badge ID. We do not collect IP/device identifiers. Exports are retained for 90 days by default; we can provide a shorter retention (30 days) on request and delete earlier by mutual agreement. We are SOC2 aligned and can share our security brief.

I've attached the booth layout for the 6x12 corner and the standard agreement. If these terms look OK, I'll send a DocuSign for signatures and the invoice for the 50% deposit.

Options we can negotiate: additional priority logo placement on the stage (extra $6k), additional 15 minutes for the session (subject to schedule), or a dedicated pre-conference webinar (add-on).

Best,
Claire

Claire —

Thanks for the clarifications. We want to move forward but propose the following counterpoints so legal and ops can sign off quickly:

1) Speaking: confirm 45 minutes (30+15) and that Redwood gets placement for a Redwood speaker + a product engineer (two speaker slots within the 45 minutes). Also request a short pre-event promo blurb in the DevSummit newsletter (distribution ~25k) and a 45-second sponsored segment in the keynote lead-in.

2) Logo & marketing: top-two row placement is acceptable. Please provide the stage mockup PNG prior to print; we need approval rights. We request the registration landing page banner as part of the package (no extra fee) and one sponsored email to registered attendees (subject to compliance review).

3) Lead capture & retention: 30-day retention is acceptable. Additionally, Redwood requires that raw exports be transmitted over SFTP or via encrypted link and that BoothWorks confirm they do not persist backups longer than 30 days. Please confirm that exports will not include badge ID mapped to device identifiers.

4) Payment/contract: we can sign with a mutually agreed MSA addendum that limits use of attendee data to Redwood marketing purposes and requires deletion after 30 days. Laura — can you flag any contract blockers in the attached MOU?

If DevSummit accepts these points we are ready to sign the DocuSign and submit the deposit.

Thanks,
Karthik
